summary: Chat autoscroll jitters and traps user at bottom during streaming
description:
Symptom: on the chat page, streamed assistant responses trigger smooth-scroll to the bottom on every token. The viewport jitters and the user is forced to watch the stream — they can't scroll up to re-read earlier content while the LLM is still responding.

Root cause: src/components/chat-view.tsx:143 — useEffect calls bottomRef.current?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'}) on every [messages, loading] change. No detection of whether the user has scrolled up; smooth-scroll on every streamed chunk compounds the jitter.

Proposed fix: stick-to-bottom pattern.
- Track whether the messages scroll container is near bottom (~80px threshold).
- Autoscroll only when sticky.
- User scrolling up flips sticky off immediately; scrolling back near bottom flips it on.
- Use instant scroll (behavior:'auto') during streaming to eliminate the per-token jitter even when autoscroll is wanted.
